question: Which exact 3.101.043 LVGL v9 veneers create labels, set label text, align objects, and preserve the stock page's bottom scroll padding?
prototype_hypothesis: sub_C588F30 implements void *lvx_label_create(void *parent); sub_C589490 implements void lvx_label_set_text(void *label, const char *text); sub_C589188 implements void lvx_object_align(void *object, uint32_t align, int32_t x, int32_t y); and sub_C5893C0 implements the three-argument bottom-padding/style setter used by stock page construction.
callsite_evidence: In exact stock caller sub_C4C3804, 0x0C4C3894 moves the parent object into R0, 0x0C4C3896 calls sub_C588F30, and 0x0C4C389A retains returned R0 as the new label. At 0x0C4C38E4-0x0C4C38E8 the retained label is passed in R0 and the text pointer in R1 to sub_C589490.

The former label-create candidate sub_C588BF8 is disproved in the same caller: 0x0C4C38C6-0x0C4C38CA passes an already-created label in R0 and integer 0 in R1. It is an existing-object property operation, not a one-argument constructor.

The former label-text candidate sub_C588A70 is disproved by exact caller sub_C4C83A0: after creating and retaining a label with sub_C588F30, 0x0C4C840A-0x0C4C8410 passes that label in R0, a packed color/property value in R1, and selector 0 in R2 to sub_C588A70.

Exact stock page constructor sub_C56D5B0 creates content with sub_CA67244 at 0x0C56D5D8, sets it to 336 by 424 with sub_C588628 at 0x0C56D5E6, then sets R0=content, R1=2, R2=0, R3=56 and calls sub_C589188 at 0x0C56D5F4. This proves the four-argument object-align ABI and the top-middle, x=0, y=56 call used by Manager.

Immediately afterward, 0x0C56D5F8-0x0C56D5FE sets R0=content, R1=32, and R2=0 before calling sub_C5893C0. No fourth argument is established, proving the three-argument ABI used to preserve the stock bottom scroll padding.

The former object-align candidate sub_C588960 is disproved by exact removal caller sub_C4C27A0: 0x0C4C27D2-0x0C4C27D6 passes only an existing object in R0 and integer 1 in R1 before calling sub_C588960, then invokes a separate removal/deletion operation.
control_flow_evidence: The stock construction order is sub_CA67244 content creation, sub_C588628 size, sub_C589188 alignment, then sub_C5893C0 bottom style/padding. The 043 Manager target backend now follows the same order.

In regenerated Supervisor SHA-256 46764ffa7f50c9740faeedcae8d682520a638838d4358645791723e45963e1c1, target_ui_apply materializes 0x0C588629 at 0x7B98, derives 0x0C589189 as 0x0C588EF1+0x298 before the BLX at 0x7BC0, and derives 0x0C5893C1 as 0x0C588EF1+0x4D0 before the BLX at 0x7BCE. Its text-node branch derives 0x0C588F31 as 0x0C588EF1+0x40 before the BLX at 0x7D06 and 0x0C589491 as 0x0C588EF1+0x5A0 before the BLX at 0x7D34.
The empty Modules view emits a CANOPUS_UI_NODE_TEXT node, so it is the first normal Manager route that exercises label construction and label-text assignment rather than only list-row helpers.

The public 0x0C58xxxx entries are runtime veneers: sub_C588BF8 jumps to 0x1C06F15D, sub_C588F30 to 0x1C06E27D, sub_C589490 to 0x1C06F039, and sub_C589188 to 0x1C02A501. The retained BusFault PC in the device log is likewise in the 0x1Cxxxxxx runtime region, consistent with a bad LVGL veneer invocation.
ownership_analysis: All four functions borrow live LVGL objects and must run on the UI owner thread. Label creation returns a child owned by the LVGL object tree; label text is borrowed according to the stock LVGL text-setter contract used by the Manager's persistent snapshot arena.
unsafe_assumptions: The exact callsites prove the public veneer identities, argument registers, and call order statically; device execution of the regenerated Supervisor remains unprobed.

The runtime implementations behind the veneers are not materialized in this static firmware IDB, so the retained 0x1C05E738 fault PC cannot be instruction-level symbolized here and is corroborating rather than dispositive evidence.
Archived fw-match rows are candidate evidence only. Their lvx_label_create, lvx_label_set_text, and lvx_object_align rows are superseded by these exact-target stock callsites.
recommended_probe: Install the regenerated exact-043 Supervisor; open Modules with zero modules installed and confirm the empty label renders without reboot; then verify a non-empty module list, module detail, back navigation, Overview layout, and full bottom scroll extent.
